opening.argument: The presentation is a technology discussion centered on Steam TV, expressly introducing the topic as “today we're going to be talking about Steam TV” and describing how “Steam can build their live streaming platform.” It also considers possible game-related information for purchasers, including that “people who buy the game can get information.” The visible game-streaming interface, with gameplay, chat, and platform controls, is consistent with that discussion, while the hosts’ gaming-related YouTube page and end card directing viewers to Twitter, Twitch, and Facebook show ordinary audience engagement. Discussion of a link or outside reporting does not itself establish a deceptive mechanism, transaction, loss, or outcome.
